# Competitor Intel Brief — 2026-07-07

# COMPETITIVE INTEL BRIEF — Week of July 7, 2026

## Executive Summary

The competitive landscape remains stable with no major positioning shifts. Mermaid Water continues aggressive promotional activity with four simultaneous offers visible on homepage (up to $200 in savings), reinforcing their foothold in our Manassas/NoVA overlap territory. EcoWater maintains national brand presence emphasizing free water tests and "Water Pro" dealer network credibility. Hampton Roads is geographically distinct (Tidewater/Richmond focus) but demonstrates strong service-area clarity and lifetime warranty messaging that resonates locally. No competitor is leading with transparent pricing; all are driving to in-home consultations.

## Per-Competitor Analysis

| Competitor | Hero positioning | Distinct services | Pricing visible? | Notable shift this week |
|------------|-----------------|-------------------|------------------|------------------------|
| **Mermaid Water** | "Get clean, healthy water and dependable plumbing" | Water + plumbing bundling; well/septic inspection; commercial DI systems; pump installation | Promo-only: $200 water heater discount, $100 new customer, free Kinetico install | None (unchanged from prior) |
| **EcoWater** | "Better Water Starts Here" — global leader, smart home focus | Smart leak detection/water monitoring; symptom-based self-diagnosis tool; third-party certified systems | No | None (unchanged from prior) |
| **Hampton Roads Water Services** | "Your Full Service Water Quality Experts" | Annual water test booking portal; bacteria/virus treatment highlighted | No (lifetime warranty featured, no $) | None (unchanged from prior) |

## Implications for ClearWave

- **Test offer stacking**: Mermaid is running 4 simultaneous promotions with clear dollar amounts. Consider limited-time bundle offers (e.g., "free annual test + $150 off softener") to compete for NoVA price-shoppers without racing to bottom.
- **Borrow symptom-based navigation**: EcoWater's "If you have scale buildup / rust stains / dry skin → you may need a softener" makes self-qualification frictionless. Our homepage should add a similar outcome-driven entry point before "Schedule Consult."
- **Emphasize dual plumbing+water capability**: Mermaid's bundling (water heater flush with softener install, drain cleaning + treatment) creates stickiness. Promote ClearWave's ability to handle both in one visit to reduce vendor fatigue.

## Watch Items

- **Mermaid promotional cadence**: Track how long the 4-offer strategy runs and whether conversion language shifts. If offers rotate weekly, we may need faster campaign cycles.
- **EcoWater smart home expansion**: Monitor whether local EcoWater dealers begin pushing leak detection/IoT aggressively in VA market (could pressure us to add connected products or partner).
- **Hampton Roads lifetime warranty details**: Confirm scope and transferability — if stronger than ours, may need warranty refresh for Richmond-area competitive responses.
